title: The most bizarre insect you’ve never heard of 🕺 This is the Wooly Aph...
description: The most bizarre insect you’ve never heard of 🕺 This is the Wooly Aphid, a small creature that often gets mistaken for cotton taking over branches of North American trees. These little forest fairies actually feed off the sap of the trees they call home and produce a white, fluffy covering on their abdomen. When Wooly Aphids are disturbed or sense predators they start rhythmically swaying back and forth which is thought to confuse other creatures enough to leave them alone but to me it looks like the grooviest dancing bug. It’s most certainly one of the weirdest occurrences I’ve stumbled across in the woods and I have my gf to thank for leading me to this joyous sight. 🎥 Captured on the @LUMIX USA S5iix with the Lumix 100mm f/2.8 Macro lens in 6k ProRes HQ Boogie on my little friends 🤘
